headline: Vantage Chemicals appoints new regional sales director
body: Vantage Chemicals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Vantage Chemicals to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Vantage Chemicals will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Curitiba. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Vantage Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Vantage Chemicals reported revenue growth of 18% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Vantage Chemicals appoints new regional sales director
body: Vantage Chemicals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Vantage Chemicals under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Vantage Chemicals over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Vantage Chemicals Curitiba facility
body: Workers at the Curitiba facility of Vantage Chemicals voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Vantage Chemicals cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Vantage Chemicals lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Vantage Chemicals reports minor shipment delays at Curitiba plant
body: Vantage Chemicals confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Curitiba plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.
